name: @amykit/plugin-file-log
description: The event log kept as one JSON Lines file per day.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: You do not add this one to a config. It is the event log the amy CLI writes, one JSON Lines file per day, and the CLI hands it to every plugin as its log; it registers no port. Depend on it only when you build your own host and want the same log on disk.
